title: Annual Financial Rpt Form
text:
RMI JUDICIAL OFFICERS ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT
To be completed by all full-time judicial officers and filed with the
Clerk of the High Court no later than January 31 of each year.
The Clerk will retain the original and forward a copy to the Clerk of the Cabinet.
1. During the previous calendar year (20_____), did you receive compensation from any source other than the RMI Judiciary?
No (proceed to #2)
Yes -- Provide the following information:
Amount Date Source Place Activity for which
compensation was received
2. For this question, exclude gifts from family members and customary and traditional gifts (e.g., gifts of food, mats, fans, etc. at
funerals, birthday parties, graduations, investitures, and similar occasions, i.e., jab koje pein ak). During the previous calendar
year, did you receive from a single source gifts or other things of value with a combined value of $100 or more?
No (proceed to #3)
Yes -- Provide the following information:
Value Date Description Source
3. For this question, exclude reimbursements and payments of expenses and waivers of fees and travel expenses from the RMI,
its donor countries and its donor agencies. During 20_____, did you receive from a single source reimbursements or
payments of expenses or waivers of fees, for travel, food, lodging, incidental expenses, registration, tuition, etc., with a
combined value of $1,000 or more?
No
Yes -- Provide the following information:
Amount Date Description Source
